text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: half-hours with CAMS irradiance below 1 W/m² (clean rows after the early-calibration cut and outside switching masks), in site-years of 17,532 half-hours. Bottom: the mean power over those dark half-hours by local hour, each site divided by its own mean; each dot is one site and half-hour, shown only where the site has at least 100 dark half-hours. D15, which carries an embedded generator, is left out.'
text.tspan: Top: half-hours with CAMS irradiance below 1 W/m² (clean rows after the early-calibration cut
and outside switching masks), in site-years of 17,532 half-hours. Bottom: the mean power over
those dark half-hours by local hour, each site divided by its own mean; each dot is one site
and half-hour, shown only where the site has at least 100 dark half-hours. D15, which carries
an embedded generator, is left out.
